{{Quote|The Nightsisters chose the strongest of their slaves and forced them to work the mines! I managed to escape and search for help, for we cannot save ourselves! Will you please help us gain our freedom?|The prisoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aeNs">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|an escaped Nightsister slave|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
An '''prisoner''' escaped the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was among the strongest of their enslaved individuals and therefore selected to work in their mines at the [[Nightsister Forced Labor Camp]].<ref name="SWG:aeNs" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the individual escaped from the Nightsisters' mines and tried to find someone who would help free the other enslaved individuals. The local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces turned his request down, as the Empire had no interest in freeing enslaved individuals. He eventually made it to the [[Trade Outpost]] near the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]], where he met an adventurer from the stars. The adventurer showed interest in the plight of the Nightsisters' enslaved individuals and promised to help them. The individual uploaded the mine's coordinates to the adventurer's datapad, hoping to see his friend again soon.<ref name="SWG:aeNs" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of the escaped Nightsister]]
The escaped prisoner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:aeNs" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The prisoner was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>

The prisoner could be found in the [[:w:c:swg:Dathomir Trade Outpost|Trade Outpost on Dathomir]]. He was one of many [[:w:c:swg:Herald NPC|herald NPCs]] that were added to the game to point players to dungeons and other points of interest. When a player talked to him and agreed to help, a [[:w:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] to the [[:w:c:swg:Nightsister Forced Labor Camp|Nightsister Forced Labor Camp]] was added to the player's datapad.<ref name="SWG:aeNs" />

Due to the nature of some characters in ''Galaxies'', his gender and appearance were randomized during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:aeNs" /> However, the description of the Nightsister Forced Labor Camp indicated that only males were enslaved by the Nightsisters.<ref name="SWG:NFLC" />
